summary_1line: Ravana’s sons march to battle; Narantaka devastates the monkey army until Angada confronts him and breaks his spear, killing his horse and turning the fight.

image_candidates.scene_text: Narantaka on a white horse charges through the monkey ranks, his blazing spear striking warriors as bodies fall around him.
Angada stands bare‑handed before Narantaka and invites the spear strike, presenting his chest on the battlefield.
Angada’s mighty palm smashes Narantaka’s horse to the ground as the demon prince reels in fury amid the chaos of war.
